sentence: This project studies random discrete systems, such as random graphs, and the threshold phenomena around them.
This project builds a security framework that uses quantum methods to protect data in the Internet of Things.
This project tries to predict trends of fecal indicator bacteria in surface water using watershed models and tracking of their sources.
This project builds a framework that joins model-based and learning-based methods for computational imaging.
This project studies how water bound in the bone matrix helps bone carry load and resist fracture.
This project sets up a cybersecurity program built around clinical rotations in a security operations center.
This project builds a system that finds areas hit by natural disasters in satellite images using deep learning.
This project builds integrated-photonic spatial light modulators that control large arrays of optical beams for quantum hardware and imaging.
This project uses computer simulations and machine learning to study how nanoparticles behave when they hit liquid surfaces.
This project builds a way for manufacturers to learn from shared data while keeping their own data private, using a private Blockchain.
This project studies how plants cope when a mitochondrial transfer RNA gene is lost and another gene takes over its role.
This project builds ways to trace and analyze attacks on deep neural networks after they happen.
This project designs artificial intelligence methods that manage mobile networks in a safe and understandable way.
This project studies how the structure and interfaces of ceramic materials affect how lithium ions move through solid-state batteries.
This project builds an optical instrument that measures fast changes in the vibrational spectra of single molecules.
This project supports a conference where researchers share discoveries about auxin, a plant hormone that controls plant growth.
